title: Beyond the Document: Compiled Context and Governed Agents for Any Work Product
abstract: arXiv:2611.13055v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A document preserves the visible result of professional work but often discards the research, calculations, assumptions, evidence, and authorization boundaries behind it. We study a different unit of delivery: a Portable Agent Format (PAF) package that carries a work product together with compiled context, evidence, provenance, and rules for subsequent interaction. To test whether this context remains useful beyond the process that produced it, we evaluate four new packages, created after the hosted and offline readers were fixed: an investment proposal, fund research, financial-statement analysis, and an engineering incident review. Two packages were produced by specialized agents and two through a general-purpose assistant's packaging skill. Across 400 frozen questions and 12,000 evaluated responses, a hosted governed reader succeeds on 96% of questions versus 86% with instructions plus raw-file retrieval (Holm-adjusted p < 10^-7). O

translated_title: 超越文档：面向任意工作成果的编译上下文与受治理智能体
translated_abstract: 文档保存了专业工作的可见成果，却往往丢弃了其背后的研究、计算、假设、证据和授权边界。我们研究了一种不同的交付单元：便携式智能体格式（Portable Agent Format, PAF）包，它将工作成果与编译后的上下文、证据、来源信息以及后续交互规则一同携带。为了检验这种上下文在产生它的过程之外是否依然有用，我们评估了四个新创建的包（均创建于托管阅读器和离线阅读器被固定之后）：一份投资提案、基金研究、财务报表分析和一份工程事故复盘。其中两个包由专用智能体生成，另外两个通过通用助手的打包技能生成。在400个冻结问题和12,000条评估回复中，托管的受治理阅读器在96%的问题上回答成功，而采用指令加原始文件检索的方式成功率为86%（经Holm校正的 p < 10^-7）。
tldr: 该论文提出便携式智能体格式（PAF）包这一新交付单元，将工作成果连同编译上下文、证据、来源与交互规则一起封装，实验证明受治理的智能体阅读器在回答相关问题上的成功率（96%）显著优于传统的指令加原始文件检索方式（86%）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Portable Agent Format (PAF) package as a new delivery unit that bundles work products with compiled context, evidence, provenance, and interaction rules, demonstrating that a governed agent reader achieves 96% question-answering success versus 86% for instruction-plus-raw-file retrieval.
